Laura Chen: Heads up — got a NorthWind security questionnaire this morning. They want clarifications on RBAC role mapping, audit log exports, and customer‑managed KMS for a potential on‑prem pilot. Pre‑sales call is tomorrow at 11am PT, can we pull answers quick?
Samir Patel: @Laura I can draft the RBAC mapping. Short answer: we support role scoping at org/team/model levels and service accounts for automation. Example mapping we send to customers:```
roles:
  - name: admin
    scope: tenant
    perms: [manage_keys, manage_models, view_audit]
  - name: app_runner
    scope: project
    perms: [invoke_model, view_metrics]
```
Maya Torres: For logs: default retention = 90d for audit logs. We can stream JSON events to customer S3, syslog, or push to their SIEM via a webhook/partner connector. We also provide a signed proof bundle for requests re: retention proof.
Samir Patel: KMS: we support CMK envelope encryption with customer keys (Cloud KMS / HSM) in both Hosted and Private modes. Key usage pattern we outline: customer-provided KEK -> envelope encrypt model artifacts & secret blobs. We do not hold unwrapped KEKs.
Evan Brooks: Can we confirm if this requires any infra changes for an on‑prem pilot? Customer asked for HSM integration and audit snapshot during runbook tests.
Maya Torres: For an on‑prem/private deployment we already have HSM integrations (PKCS#11 or cloud HSM). Work: map the customer's HSM plugin + coordinate network ACLs. Expected lift: 1–2 engineer-weeks for initial integration + test schedule.
Samir Patel: Regarding audit proofs: we can produce an export that includes an ordered sequence of audit events + SHA256 chain for tamper evidence. Example event snippet:```
{"ts":"2026-02-15T17:02:13Z","actor":"svc:webhook-01","action":"model.invoke","resource":"model/llama-13b","meta":{"latency_ms":42}}
```
Laura Chen: Great — can someone assemble a one‑page answers doc (RBAC snippet, KMS high level, logs+retention, integration lift estimate) before EOD? Evan, loop me in on the call invite. :+1:
Evan Brooks: Will do, adding Laura & Samir to the invite. Quick Q: Do we need a security contact for live demo access? Customer requires named point of contact for incident triage.
Samir Patel: Put me as primary sec contact for the pilot. Maya as infra contact. We'll provide SLOs and test plan during the call.
InfraBot: Deployment window check: next Private pilot slot available week of 2026-03-02. Reply "CONFIRM" to reserve.
Laura Chen: CONFIRM — reserving that slot. I'll draft the answers and ping for review in #eng-security in ~2h.
Maya Torres: I'll attach the log schema and SIEM mapping after lunch.
Samir Patel: I'll prepare the RBAC sample + KMS FAQ.
Evan Brooks: Thanks team — this should close the pre‑sales asks.
